lines: css holds 3 stylesheets, 2,704 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Named nowhere in lib/, templates/ or src/: style.css 2,045 B.
Unless something outside lib/, templates/ or src/ loads the ones named nowhere, no page receives them. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
107 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (132 packages, 1,208 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
